hypothesis: The parent's critical-pair locality term uses saturated criticality (1-rank_q) on the node's own slack only; replacing the per-pin weight by the product of the pin's criticality and the net's maximum-pin criticality (i.e. only nets that actually touch a critical pin get locality pressure) sharpens the term on genuine critical nets without changing its magnitude, reducing crit_cross on the big circuit while leaving C1's gain intact.
